classification.difficultyReason: Add the labelled side lengths, use equal-side markings and collect like terms.

content.prompt: Write an algebraic expression for the perimeter of each figure.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base and vertical right side; no right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: Base a, right side b and sloping side c.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side labels are visible.

spec.description: Upright triangle with each side labelled x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side labels are visible.

spec.description: Square-shaped quadrilateral with one congruence tick on each side and no angle markers.
spec.mathematics: All four sides are equal; the bottom side is d.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied bottom label and congruence ticks are visible.

answer.worked:
The markings show that every side has length $d$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=d+d+d+d\\P&=4d\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Irregular quadrilateral with a horizontal bottom and three sloping sides.
spec.mathematics: Upper side a, right side 2b, bottom side 3a and left side 4b.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side labels are visible.

spec.description: Upright triangle with a horizontal base.
spec.mathematics: Both sloping sides are 4a and the base is 3b.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side labels are visible.

spec.description: Rectangle-shaped quadrilateral with single ticks on top and bottom, double ticks on left and right, and no angle markers.
spec.mathematics: Bottom side 7x and right side 6y; opposite sides have matching congruence markings.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied labels and congruence ticks are visible.

answer.worked:
Matching markings show two sides of length $7x$ and two sides of length $6y$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=7x+6y+7x+6y\\P&=14x+12y\end{align*}$$
